messages:
Nina: started a tiny PR to add a migration note for customers moving from our hosted KMS to local HSM in private installs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501
docs-bot: Nina opened PR #501 — title: 'Migration: hosted KMS -> local HSM (private installs)'
Marco: nice. can we include a short checklist for key material export requirements and a reminder about vendor onboarding paperwork? customers forget the HSM vendor cert step
Eve: added a 3-step checklist: export key policy review, vendor attestation, local import using pkcs11-tool. pushed a commit
Nina: thanks — also include an example pkcs11-tool import command and a note about slot selection on Thales/Luna devices
Eve: added example: pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so --login --write-object key.pem --type privkey --label "redwood-migration"
Infra-Eng: small networking note: when moving to private HSM, ensure the HSM mgmt IPs are reachable from the installer host and add an ACL snippet for VPC peering routes. I'll paste an example in the PR
Marco: also call out that customers using our offline installer should set KMS_SHIM_SOCKET to empty and use KMS_PKCS11_LIB env instead — avoids shim socket confusion in airgapped mode
Nina: added env guidance and a short troubleshooting tip: if the installer fails with "no PKCS11 slots" check vendor daemon and that pkcs11 lib path is correct (include common paths for deb/rpm)
Eve: lint/links check flagged a broken HSM vendor link in the doc—fixed the URL and updated the changelog entry
docs-bot: PR #501 updated by Eve (files changed: 3). CI: lint passed, links passed, sample-run queued
Nina: requesting review from @Marco and @Infra-Eng. plan to merge after sample-run completes in morning
